title: Biome Roulette
description: A Mod That Gives You Random Effects Per Biome.
body:
# Biome Roulette
A Mod Made Specifically As A Minigame For Creators. It Is A Lightweight Mod That Does Not Affect Performance In Any Way.

## What It Does?
It Gives You A Random Effect Every Time You Enter Or Spawn In Any Biome.
 
- - - 

**Specifications:**
- Negative & Positive Effects
- Effects Are **Not** Stackable
- Effect Is Removed The Moment You Exit A Biome
- Effects Are Random, **Not** Set
- Effects Are Not Stackable Above Vanilla Levels
- An Effect Can **Not** Be Repeated Twice In One Go.
 > __Example:__
```
Plains - Speed II
Desert - Picks Random Effect EXCLUDING Speed
 > Strength
Taiga - Picks Random Effect EXCLUDING Strength INCLUDING Speed
```
  
## Compatibility
**Fabric API:** 0.116.12+1.21.1
**Fabric Loader:** 0.16.9
**Minecraft:** 1.21.1 - Java (Listed As 1.21.1-1.21.11 But Due To Fabric API Syntax Differences It May Crash If Used In Any Version Newer Or Older Than 1.21.1).

## General
- As Of Now, It Is Compatible With Custom Loaders/Clients Such As __Lunar Client__.
- Bannable On Multiplayer Servers - Adds Multiple Advantages In PvP Based Gamemodes & Is Modifying Vanilla Minecraft.
- Dimensions - Overworld Only
- Recommended To Be Used With - Large Biomes
